description: Generate a 1D barcode as SVG (plus base64 data URI and the raw module pattern): Code 128 (any ASCII, automatic A / B / C subset switching for the shortest symbol), GS1-128 shipping / logistics labels from "(01)…(17)…(10)…" application identifiers (FNC1 separators, SSCC / GTIN check digits verified), EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A and ITF-14 (check digit computed when omitted, verified when given) and Code 39 (optional mod-43 check). Options: module width, bar height, quiet zone, human-readable text, colours. For product labels, shipping cartons, inventory and tickets. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/barcode-generate

checksum.description: Code 39: append the mod-43 check character

data.description: Content to encode (digits for EAN / UPC / ITF)

text.description: Print the human-readable text under the bars
